description: A primitive 3D Mass — Cube (Length) · Cuboid (Length × Breadth × Height) · Sphere (Radius) · Cone (Radius, Height) · Cylinder (Radius, Height). Rendered in the 3D view as a starting Mass.
instructions:
A primitive 3D Mass generator (no input) — a Cube / Cuboid / Sphere / Cone / Cylinder of the given dimensions, rendered in the 3D view. A starting Mass to feed downstream Mass ops (Inset 3D / Smoothing 3D).

Only the dimensions relevant to the chosen shape are shown (Cube → Length; Cuboid → L × B × H; Sphere → Radius; Cone / Cylinder → Radius + Height).

NOTE: unlike the newer Cuboid / Cylinder primitives, Mass carries its own colour and feeds the Mass-op chain.
